objective: Balance visitor value, organic audience growth and sustainable funding. Preserve Open Live Source as an honest source handoff; monetize only around useful planning and voluntary source-owner partnerships, never by changing Earth ranking, source truth or currentness.

signals.meaning: Visitors are moving from discovery into planning/commercial intent.

Visitors find source handoffs useful. Aggregate source-specific outbound opens can support future source-owner partnership outreach, but clicks do not imply endorsement, permission, conversion or revenue.

A source owner with a genuine ERN traffic relationship and clear visitor utility may become a future referral, benefit, affiliate or verified-source partner after separate human outreach and agreement.
Sustained destination search activity demonstrates intentional discovery rather than passive page views.
Repeated gaps reveal where content expansion may unlock future planning demand.
Repeated place exploration helps distinguish useful destination demand from homepage impressions.
A confirmed booking/sale/commission in a partner dashboard is the strongest evidence that ERN commercial traffic is working.

currentOperatingEvidence.interpretation: ERN has real discovery, source-handoff and planning activity. Search volume and window opens are rising, while share activity remains unproven. Use destination demand and unresolved search gaps to choose growth work; use source-specific opens for future partner qualification only.
currentOperatingEvidence.caveat: Privacy-preserving rolling aggregate evidence only. Clicks do not prove bookings, conversions, commission or revenue; destination ranking cannot use commercial value.

balanceRules: Open Live Source always remains an honest path to the genuine provider/source; it is never silently replaced by an affiliate or paid destination.
Source owners may later become ERN partners, referral partners or visitor-benefit partners, but payment cannot change Earth ranking, truth, currentness or source inclusion.
Prefer win-win partner structures: useful visitor benefit or planning utility + measurable referral value + optional ERN commission, rather than intrusive advertising.
Aggregate external_source_opened evidence may prioritize outreach, but small click counts are observation evidence only and do not justify relationship claims.
Visitor value comes first within each experience: show the truthful Earth window before planning actions.
Audience growth is a first-class operating goal: improve crawlable destination sharing, search discovery, useful return paths and organic distribution.
Funding is a first-class sustainability goal: expose only verified, contextually useful affiliate actions after destination interest is established.
Do not add commercial buttons merely to raise offer counts.
Commission rate, partner status or payout cannot affect Earth ranking, source health, currentness or editorial prominence.
Use travel_option_opened as planning-intent evidence only; never treat it as a booking or commission.
Use partner-dashboard evidence for conversions and commission.
Prefer converting existing active-program coverage over opening more programs until traffic and planning demand justify them.
Demand-led planning expansion should prioritize places with real source/destination engagement plus a current useful exact product; it must not influence Earth ranking.
Travelpayouts Drive remains site-wide OFF; any future experiment must be planning-surface-only, owner-approved, reversible and must never rewrite Open Live Source.
Do not treat Travelpayouts promotional earnings examples as ERN forecasts.
nextOperatingPriorities: Expand globally from strong first-party/public-authority current sources rather than repeatedly revisiting weak unresolved gaps.
Grow qualified entry traffic through crawlable destination, collection and country paths chosen from actual search/open demand.
Use the new Thailand discovery collection as a demand-led organic/AI-search entry path without changing source eligibility.
Rotate selective manual social sharing toward deep destination/collection links instead of only the homepage; compare aggregate referral behavior without inferring causation.
Improve repeat utility through current-place discovery, saved/recent places and trustworthy source maintenance.
Keep verified planning actions downstream from place interest and measure travel_option_opened by destination/provider.
Qualify source-owner outreach only after repeated source-specific outbound value plus a clear visitor benefit.

publicCommercialCoverage.evidence: Reconciled from the same commercial-placement gates used by Operations after Phuket/Karon activation.

travelpayoutsDrive.principle: Funding may grow through explicit planning utility, but Drive must not turn ERN into an affiliate-first travel site.

globalExpansion.principle: Expand toward places with trustworthy current sources instead of repeatedly forcing unresolved gaps.
globalExpansion.newestNetwork: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Izu/Ogasawara port live cameras
globalExpansion.planningRule: Add commercial planning only where a real useful downstream option exists; a new Earth source does not require monetization.
